title: Restore Finishing Order
summary: Given an integer array order of length n representing the finishing order of a race, where each integer from 1 to n appears exactly once, and an integer array friends containing the IDs of your friends sorted in strictly increasing order, return an array containing the IDs of your friends in the order they finished the race.
statement: Given an integer array order of length n representing the finishing order of a race, where each integer from 1 to n appears exactly once, and an integer array friends containing the IDs of your friends sorted in strictly increasing order, return an array containing the IDs of your friends in the order they finished the race.
constraints: order is a permutation describing all race finishers.
friends lists selected racer IDs, but not their finishing order.
Return only friend IDs in the order they appear in the race result.
hints: Place friend IDs in a membership set.
Append each finisher who belongs to the friend set.
Filtering this way preserves exactly the race order.
editorial: Filtering this way preserves exactly the race order.
